sql: WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT date(MIN(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<(SELECT date(MAX(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), nets AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,m), spine AS (SELECT c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN nets n ON c.customer_id=n.customer_id AND m.m=n.m), closings AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM spine), totals AS (SELECT m,SUM(MAX(closing,0)) total_clipped_balance,SUM(closing) total_raw_balance,SUM(MAX(net,0)) total_clipped_net FROM closings GROUP BY m), shifted AS (SELECT m,LAG(total_clipped_balance) OVER(ORDER BY m) previous_total_balance FROM totals) SELECT m,total_clipped_balance,total_raw_balance,MAX(total_raw_balance,0) clip_after_users,total_clipped_net,SUM(total_clipped_net) OVER(ORDER BY m) clip_nets_then_cumulative FROM totals ORDER BY m

SELECT txn_type,COUNT(*) n,MIN(txn_date) earliest,MAX(txn_date) latest,SUM(CASE WHEN substr(txn_date,9,2)='01' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) first_day_amount FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY txn_type

WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT date(MIN(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<(SELECT date(MAX(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), nets AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,m), spine AS (SELECT c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN nets n ON c.customer_id=n.customer_id AND m.m=n.m), closings AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM spine), totals AS (SELECT m,SUM(MAX(closing,0)) total_clipped_balance,SUM(closing) total_raw_balance,SUM(MAX(net,0)) total_clipped_net FROM closings GROUP BY m), shifted AS (SELECT m,LAG(total_clipped_balance) OVER(ORDER BY m) previous_total_balance FROM totals) SELECT customer_id,m,net,closing,MAX(closing,0) clipped_closing FROM closings WHERE customer_id IN(1,3,10) ORDER BY customer_id,m

WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT date(MIN(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<(SELECT date(MAX(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), nets AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,m), spine AS (SELECT c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN nets n ON c.customer_id=n.customer_id AND m.m=n.m), closings AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM spine), totals AS (SELECT m,SUM(MAX(closing,0)) total_clipped_balance,SUM(closing) total_raw_balance,SUM(MAX(net,0)) total_clipped_net FROM closings GROUP BY m), shifted AS (SELECT m,LAG(total_clipped_balance) OVER(ORDER BY m) previous_total_balance FROM totals) SELECT m month,previous_total_balance FROM shifted WHERE m>(SELECT MIN(m) FROM months) ORDER BY m

WITH modes(mode) AS (SELECT 'all_types' UNION ALL SELECT 'dw_only'), nets AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount WHEN txn_type='withdrawal' OR mode='all_types' THEN -txn_amount ELSE 0 END) net FROM customer_transactions CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode='all_types' OR txn_type IN('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), balances AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) closing FROM nets), prev AS (SELECT *,LAG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) previous_closing,LAG(m) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) previous_m FROM balances) SELECT mode,m,COUNT(*) current_active_customers,SUM(MAX(COALESCE(previous_closing,0),0)) clipped_previous_observed,SUM(CASE WHEN previous_m=date(m,'-1 month') THEN MAX(previous_closing,0) ELSE 0 END) clipped_previous_calendar_active,SUM(previous_m<>date(m,'-1 month')) gap_customers FROM prev WHERE m>'2020-01-01' GROUP BY mode,m ORDER BY mode,m

WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT date(MIN(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<(SELECT date(MAX(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), nets AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,m), spine AS (SELECT c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN nets n ON c.customer_id=n.customer_id AND m.m=n.m), closings AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM spine), totals AS (SELECT m,SUM(MAX(closing,0)) total_clipped_balance,SUM(closing) total_raw_balance,SUM(MAX(net,0)) total_clipped_net FROM closings GROUP BY m), shifted AS (SELECT m,LAG(total_clipped_balance) OVER(ORDER BY m) previous_total_balance FROM totals) SELECT a.m,SUM(MAX(b.closing,0)) full_all_users,SUM(CASE WHEN n.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(b.closing,0) ELSE 0 END) prior_balance_current_active,SUM(CASE WHEN n.customer_id IS NULL THEN MAX(b.closing,0) ELSE 0 END) dropped_inactive_balance,SUM(n.customer_id IS NULL AND b.closing>0) dropped_positive_users FROM closings a JOIN closings b ON a.customer_id=b.customer_id AND b.m=date(a.m,'-1 month') LEFT JOIN nets n ON a.customer_id=n.customer_id AND a.m=n.m GROUP BY a.m ORDER BY a.m

WITH months(month) AS (
  SELECT '2020-02' UNION ALL SELECT '2020-03' UNION ALL SELECT '2020-04'
), signed AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
         CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END AS amt
  FROM customer_transactions
), cust_bal AS (
  SELECT m.month AS month, s.customer_id AS customer_id, SUM(s.amt) AS bal
  FROM months m JOIN signed s ON s.txn_date < m.month || '-01'
  GROUP BY m.month, s.customer_id
)
SELECT month, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bal < 0 THEN 0 ELSE bal END) AS INTEGER) AS total_balance
FROM cust_bal
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT date(MIN(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<(SELECT date(MAX(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), nets AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,m), spine AS (SELECT c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN nets n ON c.customer_id=n.customer_id AND m.m=n.m), closings AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM spine), totals AS (SELECT m,SUM(MAX(closing,0)) total_clipped_balance,SUM(closing) total_raw_balance,SUM(MAX(net,0)) total_clipped_net FROM closings GROUP BY m), shifted AS (SELECT m,LAG(total_clipped_balance) OVER(ORDER BY m) previous_total_balance FROM totals) SELECT a.customer_id,a.m,b.closing prior_closing,a.net current_net FROM closings a JOIN closings b ON a.customer_id=b.customer_id AND b.m=date(a.m,'-1 month') WHERE a.m='2020-04-01' AND b.closing>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nets n WHERE a.customer_id=n.customer_id AND a.m=n.m) ORDER BY a.customer_id LIMIT 10
